recommendedTextbook.title: Essential Geography for Senior Secondary Schools
recommendedTextbook.author: O. A. Iwena
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

topics.topic: The Earth as a Planet: Planetary Proofs and Solar System
subtopics: The solar system: Position of the Earth, sun, eight planets, and asteroid belt
Proofs of the Earth's sphericity: Circumnavigation, ship's hull emergence, circular shadow during lunar eclipse, aerial photography
Dimensions of the Earth: Equatorial circumference, polar diameter, and surface area
objectives: List the planets of the solar system in order of distance from the sun
Provide 5 empirical proofs confirming that the Earth is spherical
Calculate distances on the Earth's surface using latitude degrees

topics.topic: Earth Rotation and Revolution: Day, Night and Seasons
subtopics: Rotation of the Earth on its inclined axis (23.5°): Day and night, Coriolis force, time calculation across standard time zones
Revolution of the Earth around the sun in 365.25 days: Equinoxes (March 21, Sept 23), Solstices (June 21, Dec 22)
Calculation of local solar time and Greenwich Mean Time (GMT)
objectives: Explain 4 distinct physical consequences of the Earth's rotation
Calculate local time for cities given their longitudinal degrees east or west of the Greenwich Meridian
Diagram the four annual seasonal positions of the Earth relative to the sun

topics.topic: Internal Structure of the Earth and Lithosphere
subtopics: Concentric layers: The crust (SIAL and SIMA), the mantle (Asthenosphere), the core (Barysphere / NIFE)
Temperature and pressure gradients within the Earth's interior
objectives: Draw and label a cross-sectional diagram of the internal structure of the Earth
Distinguish continental SIAL from oceanic SIMA crustal plates
State mineral compositions and physical states of the outer and inner core

topics.topic: Classification of Rocks and Economic Importance
subtopics: Igneous rocks: Plutonic (granite) vs volcanic (basalt) formation from magma/lava
Sedimentary rocks: Mechanically, organically, and chemically formed rocks (sandstone, limestone, coal)
Metamorphic rocks: Thermal and regional metamorphism (marble from limestone, slate from shale)
objectives: Classify 12 common rocks into their primary geological groups
Explain how stratification and fossilization occur in sedimentary rock beds
Highlight the economic value of rocks in the Nigerian mining and construction industry
